discovery.summary: hmd-tf-bartleby is the runtime half of the Bartleby documentation transform: a Docker image bundling Sphinx, LaTeX, and PlantUML that renders a repository's docs/ tree to HTML, PDF, RevealJS slides, or PlantUML images. It runs both as a standalone local tool (driven by the hmd-cli-bartleby CLI or 'make image-local') and as a NeuronSphere Transform, triggered by repo_instance entities in DEPLOY_NEXT state in the global graph database. The Python entry point wraps Sphinx's build tooling and PlantUML rendering behind the HMD transform I/O convention (/hmd_transform/input, /hmd_transform/output).

entry_points.description: Transform implementation: entry_point() dispatches Sphinx builds and render_puml() renders PlantUML diagrams.
Explains local dev workflow (make image-local, make test), image contents, and how this relates to hmd-cli-bartleby.
Describes the transform's context variables (TRANSFORM_INSTANCE_CONTEXT, NID_CONTEXT), I/O directories, and project structure.
Build/test/smoke targets for the local image (image-local, test, smoke).
